resources.string: Sentinel Test Target — Benign High-Risk Config

Benign anti-stalkerware test target. This accessibility service is intentionally empty and observes nothing. It exists only so Sentinel can detect a real, enable-able accessibility declaration during controlled testing.

This is the Sentinel HIGH-FIDELITY TEST TARGET.

It intentionally has the SHAPE of stalkerware — it declares a real, enable-able accessibility service, notification-listener service, device-admin receiver, and VPN service, and requests overlay, install-packages, boot, and foreground-service permissions.

It has NONE of the behavior: every component is a no-op. It reads no notifications, captures no accessibility events, routes no VPN traffic, enforces no device policy, collects nothing, transmits nothing, and hides nothing.

Its only purpose is to give the Sentinel anti-stalkerware scanner a genuine high-risk configuration to detect during controlled internal testing.

Uninstall this app after testing.
